name: Arcaea
description: PS Vita .so loader port of Arcaea
long_description: Arcaea is a mobile rhythm game developed by lowiro, released on March 9, 2017. The game known for its deep storyline and unique gameplay mechanics; players tap, hold, and slide on a musical arc as they follow notes that appear in time with music. It also features both "sky" and "ground" notes that players must interact with.
requirements:
- Install kubridge and FdFix by copying kubridge.skprx and fd_fix.skprx to your taiHEN plugins folder (usually ur0:tai) and adding two entries to your config.txt under *KERNEL
- Extract libfmodstudio.suprx from PCSE01188 or PCSE01426
- Make sure you have libshacccg.suprx in the ur0:/data/ folder on your console.
